originalTitle: 3 Bank Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar
summary: Banks serve as the backbone of the economy, facilitating lending, deposits, and financial services that keep businesses and consumers moving forward. But worries about an economic slowdown and potential credit deterioration have kept sentiment in check, and over the past six months, the banking industry’s 6.5% return has trailed the S&P 500 by 1.8 percentage points.
content:
Banks serve as the backbone of the economy, facilitating lending, deposits, and financial services that keep businesses and consumers moving forward. But worries about an economic slowdown and potential credit deterioration have kept sentiment in check, and over the past six months, the banking industry's 6.5% return has trailed the S&P 500 by 1.8 percentage points.

How are banking stocks performing versus market?

Why is Eastern Bank considered unattractive?

What are Enterprise Financial Services' key weaknesses?

Why do analysts avoid Home Bancshares stock?

A cautious approach is imperative when dabbling in banks as many are sensitive to interest rate changes and economic cycles. With that said, here are three bank stocks we would avoid.

Founded in Conway, Arkansas in 1998 and growing through strategic acquisitions across the Southeast, Home Bancshares (NYSE:HOMB) operates as the bank holding company for Centennial Bank, providing commercial and retail banking services to businesses and individuals across multiple states.

Net interest income trends were unexciting over the last five years as its 9.6% annual growth was below the typical banking firm

Estimated net interest income growth of 5.7% for the next 12 months implies demand will slow from its five-year trend

Annual earnings per share growth of 6.1% underperformed its revenue over the last five years, showing its incremental sales were less profitable

At $31.07 per share, Home Bancshares trades at 1.3x forward P/B. Read our free research report to see why you should think twice about including HOMB in your portfolio, it's free .

Enterprise Financial Services (EFSC)

Starting as a single bank in Missouri in 1988 and expanding through strategic growth, Enterprise Financial Services (NASDAQ:EFSC) is a financial holding company that offers banking, lending, and wealth management services to businesses and individuals across seven states.

Sales trends were unexciting over the last two years as its 8.4% annual growth was below the typical banking company

Day-to-day expenses have swelled relative to revenue over the last four years as its efficiency ratio increased by 9.4 percentage points

Performance over the past two years shows its incremental sales were less profitable, as its 3.6% annual earnings per share growth trailed its revenue gains

Enterprise Financial Services is trading at $66.31 per share, or 1.2x forward P/B. To fully understand why you should be careful with EFSC, check out our full research report (it's free) .

Founded in 1818 as one of America's oldest mutual banks before converting to a public company in 2020, Eastern Bankshares (NASDAQ:EBC) operates as a bank holding company providing commercial and retail banking services primarily in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island.

Net interest margin of 3.5% is well below other banks, signaling its loans aren't very profitable

Annual tangible book value per share declines of 4.9% for the past five years show its capital management struggled during this cycle

Below-average return on equity indicates management struggled to find compelling investment opportunities

Eastern Bank's stock price of $22.96 implies a valuation ratio of 1.2x forward P/B. Check out our free in-depth research report to learn more about why EBC doesn't pass our bar .

chineseTitle: 我们不关注的 3 只银行股
chineseSummary: 银行是经济的支柱，促进贷款、存款和金融服务，推动企业和消费者向前发展。但对经济放缓和潜在信用恶化的担忧抑制了市场情绪，过去六个月，银行业 6.5% 的回报率落后标准普尔 500 指数 1.8 个百分点。
chineseContent:
银行是经济的支柱，促进贷款、存款和金融服务，推动企业和消费者向前发展。但对经济放缓和潜在信用恶化的担忧抑制了市场情绪，过去六个月，银行业 6.5% 的回报率落后标准普尔 500 指数 1.8 个百分点。

银行股与市场的表现如何？

为什么东方银行被认为没有吸引力？

企业金融服务的主要弱点是什么？

为什么分析师回避 Home Bancshares 股票？

涉足银行业时必须采取谨慎态度，因为许多银行对利率变化和经济周期很敏感。话虽如此，以下是我们会避开的三只银行股。

Home Bancshares (NYSE:HOMB) 于 1998 年在阿肯色州康威成立，通过在东南部地区的战略收购不断发展壮大，作为 Centennial Bank 的银行控股公司，为多个州的企业和个人提供商业和零售银行服务。

过去五年的净利息收入趋势并不令人兴奋，其 9.6% 的年增长率低于典型的银行公司

预计未来 12 个月净利息收入增长 5.7%，意味着需求将较五年趋势放缓

过去五年每股收益增长 6.1% 低于其收入，表明其增量销售利润较低

Home Bancshares 的股价为每股 31.07 美元，远期市净率为 1.3 倍。请阅读我们的免费研究报告，了解为什么您应该三思而后行，将 HOMB 纳入您的投资组合中，它是免费的。

企业金融服务 (EFSC)

Enterprise Financial Services（纳斯达克股票代码：EFSC）于 1988 年在密苏里州作为一家单一银行起步，并通过战略增长进行扩张，是一家金融控股公司，为七个州的企业和个人提供银行、贷款和财富管理服务。

过去两年的销售趋势并不令人兴奋，年增长率为 8.4%，低于典型的银行公司

过去四年，随着效率比率提高 9.4 个百分点，日常开支相对于收入有所增加

过去两年的业绩表明，其增量销售利润较低，每股收益增长 3.6%，落后于收入增长

Enterprise Financial Services 的交易价格为每股 66.31 美元，即 1.2 倍远期市净率。要充分了解为什么您应该谨慎对待 EFSC，请查看我们的完整研究报告（免费）。

Eastern Bankshares（纳斯达克股票代码：EBC）成立于 1818 年，是美国历史最悠久的互惠银行之一，于 2020 年转为上市公司，是一家银行控股公司，主要在马萨诸塞州、新罕布什尔州和罗德岛州提供商业和零售银行服务。

3.5%的净息差远低于其他银行，表明其贷款利润并不高

过去五年每股有形账面价值每年下降 4.9%，表明其资本管理在此周期陷入困境

低于平均水平的股本回报率表明管理层难以找到有吸引力的投资机会

东方银行的股价为 22.96 美元，意味着其估值率为 1.2 倍的远期市净率。查看我们的免费深入研究报告，详细了解 EBC 为何未通过我们的标准。
